long_description:
Join us for this fall themed Yoga and Art session. Unwind and get creative with a chill yoga practice followed by a fun art workshop!

About this Event

Join Our Yoga and Art Mini-Retreat!Looking to unwind and get creative? This in-person mini-retreat blends gentle, calming yoga sessions with a soulfut art activity. Perfect for all skill levels, you'll stretch your body and express yourself through art in a relaxed, friendly setting. Bring a mat, an open mind, and get ready to refresh your body and spirit! All Art supplies provided and you leave with your own expressive art piece! If weather cooperates, the yoga will be outside in the beautiful peaceful courtyard.
